title: Returning Buyer Rate on Homesite Reservation Extension Fees
content:
A buyer who has bought a Calloway home before pays the class's extension fee for a Homesite Reservation hold extension at a returning buyer rate, the extension lender rate, set by the financing type of the buyer's earlier Home Purchase Agreement that stands closed.

## Rate card

| Buyer's earlier Calloway Home Purchase Agreement | Extension lender rate |
|---|---|
| stands closed with financing type Calloway Home Mortgage | 60 percent |
| stands closed with financing type outside lender or cash | 80 percent |
| no closed Calloway Home Purchase Agreement | one hundred percent |

## Questions on the rate card

**The buyer's earlier agreement closed with cash. Which rate?** 80 percent; cash and outside lender carry the same rate.

**The buyer's only Home Purchase Agreement is still under construction. Which rate?** One hundred percent; the agreement does not stand closed.

**The buyer has two closed agreements, both financed through Calloway Home Mortgage. Which rate?** 60 percent; the records show a closed agreement with financing type Calloway Home Mortgage.
